bibliographic.title: Creation: Dawn of a New God
bibliographic.author: Liam Reichdan
bibliographic.description:
God opens their eyes to behold an unshaped mass. This is your world. You will shape it to your will and populate it with your creations. As you decide how to govern your creations, you discover who you are as a god and how your actions impact the world you have created.

This game was created as a senior project exploring the benefits of worldbuilding. It was designed to teach you how to worldbuild on your own.

Enjoy!
